data.name: Philly Ball
data.detailed_description:
WE HEARD YOU! 3-PLAYER SUPPORT IN FREE-FOR-ALL MODE!

After numerous suggestions, we are adding a free-for-all mode. Available for the 30th Street Station and the Benjamin Parkway map. Score in any goal, but not yours, you silly!

PHILLY BALL

Enjoy the festivities of Summer 2026. Philly Ball turns the city into a playable soccer playground. Compete now across Philly-inspired arenas like the Liberty Bell, 30th Street Station, and Benjamin Franklin Parkway, as well as the frozen docks off Boathouse Row. Each map brings its own local flavour, hazards, and madness to every match.

Pick from all the countries qualified for the World's largest international tournament, grab a friend or 2, and play up to 4 player co-op. Fight for bragging rights with rapid decision-making and smart manoeuvres. Whether you clone yourself to raise an army of players against your opponents or trigger a ground-shattering earthquake to clear the path to the goal, every match presents fun opportunities to crown yourself as the king of Soccer in the birthplace of the USA.

Gameplay Features

  • Arcade Soccer Madness:
    Kick, tackle, jump, and scramble your way through fast matches where every goal feels earned and every mistake gets punished immediately.

  • Philly-Inspired Arenas:
    Play across locations inspired by the Liberty Bell, 30th Street Station, and more. Each map brings a different slice of authentic Philly energy to the field.

  • Play for Your Country:
    Choose from nations qualified for the biggest iteration of the beautiful game on the international stage.

  • Wacky Powerups:
    Turn the tides with Shadow Clone, Multiball, Empowered Kick, and Earthquake. Every power-up can completely change the pace of a match.

  • Couch Co-op Competition:
    Built for friends in the same room, Philly Ball is about loud reactions, quick rematches, and the kind of chaos that makes people crowd around the screen or an arcade machine.

data.short_description: Aracde soccer meets classic Philadelphia chaos. Pick a country, hit the couch, fool your friends, and kick them into oblivion as you unleash ridiculous power-ups across iconic locations inspired by the City of Brotherly Love.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS *: Windows 7, 64-bit or later
  • Processor: 2.4Ghz Dual Core Processer or higher
  • Memory: 500 MB RAM
  • Graphics: Graphics card with DX9 capabilities
  • DirectX: Version 9.0
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: 2 to 4 players with controllers. No Keyboard&Mouse support yet.

Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
